description: Set up a new open-source project's first month so it can grow without eating its maintainer — the README that routes people correctly, CONTRIBUTING boundaries written before there are contributors, issue templates that pre-triage, a release rhythm, and the sustainability defaults (what you owe no one). Use when someone says 'my repo is getting attention', 'I just open-sourced something', 'set up my project properly', or their first PR from a stranger just landed.
